items.question: What services does HULEGEB currently provide?
items.answer: HULEGEB currently provides veterinary services, artificial insemination services, and livestock consultation services.

items.question: Does HULEGEB provide veterinary services?
items.answer: Yes. Veterinary services are one of HULEGEB’s current service areas and are focused on supporting livestock health and animal care.

items.question: Does HULEGEB provide artificial insemination services?
items.answer: Yes. Artificial insemination is one of HULEGEB’s current services and supports improved breeding management for livestock owners.

items.question: What kind of livestock consultation does HULEGEB provide?
items.answer: HULEGEB provides livestock consultation to support better health, breeding, and management decisions for farmers and livestock owners.

items.question: Who can use HULEGEB services?
items.answer: HULEGEB services are intended for livestock owners, farmers, and people seeking professional support for animal health, breeding, and livestock management.

items.question: Where does HULEGEB currently provide services?
items.answer: HULEGEB’s current services are delivered through its operational service areas and local livestock service activities.

items.question: Is HULEGEB already offering a digital livestock platform?
items.answer: Not as a current service offering. HULEGEB’s broader digital livestock platform concept represents future development and innovation, while current operations remain focused on veterinary, AI, and consultation services.

items.question: What is the future vision of HULEGEB?
items.answer: HULEGEB’s future vision includes exploring digital livestock services, technology-enabled coordination, and data-driven solutions that can strengthen livestock support over time.

who.title: About HULEGEB
who.paragraphShort: HULEGEB is a livestock service initiative focused on providing professional veterinary, artificial insemination, and livestock consultation services.
who.moreParagraph: HULEGEB is dedicated to supporting livestock owners with practical, professional, and farmer-centered services that improve animal health, breeding outcomes, and management decisions.
who.overlayText: Our work centers on helping farmers access dependable support for livestock health, breeding, and management in a practical and locally responsive way.

mission.title: Mission & Vision
mission.missionText: To provide accessible, professional, and quality-focused veterinary, artificial insemination, and livestock consultation services that support healthier animals, improved breeding, and better livestock management.
mission.visionText: To become a trusted livestock service provider that combines professional expertise, quality service, and innovation to contribute to improved livestock health, productivity, and farmer livelihoods.

list.title: Professionalism
list.text: We deliver services with expertise, responsibility, and quality-focused care.

list.title: Integrity
list.text: We build trust through honest, transparent, and respectful service.

list.title: Quality
list.text: We aim for dependable service that supports good livestock outcomes.

list.title: Farmer-Centered Service
list.text: We focus on practical support that meets the needs of farmers and livestock owners.

list.title: Innovation
list.text: We continue to explore solutions that strengthen livestock services over time.
